Flying
{U}, Sacrifice this creature: Counter target spell or ability that targets you or a creature you control.
blocked_sentences: {U}, Sacrifice this creature: Counter target spell or ability that targets you or a creature you control.

needs.what: a target-spec selector clause for a stack object (spell or ability) that matches by what that object itself targets: 'targets you or a creature you control', i.e. one of its chosen targets is the ability's controller or a creature permanent that player controls, honoured by both candidates and still_legal for kind spell_or_ability
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The counter op and the spell_or_ability target kind exist, but no selector key reads a stack object's own targets; the ability matcher (targeting._ability_matches) honours only controller and ability_kind, and the spell matcher reads printed characteristics only, so dropping the restriction would make it a strictly wider counter-anything ability
